correctness.rationale: The affine discriminant normalization (a,b)↔(X,Y) is bijective in odd characteristic; z_j=X+jY+j². In char2, independent absolute trace constraints for a≠0,u give q(q-2)/4; char3 reduces to three distinct shifts and pairwise zero-line corrections giving (q-1)(q-3)/8. In char>=5, expansion of four nonsquare indicators, triple correlations, fourth correlation q-U_q, and zero-discriminant inclusion–exclusion yield the stated formula; Hasse bounds reduce existence to q<11 and explicit small cases. Independent root enumeration for p=2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19 matches formula (counts 0,0,0,1,4,6,12,14). Extension fields not independently replayed this time; finite checks do not establish all-q proof.
